long_biography.plain_text:
Oil and energy infrastructure have defined Sergei Vladimirovich Maslov's executive career. After earlier work in oil-industry companies, he led the state oil-products pipeline operator Transnefteprodukt for seven years. He then became president of the St Petersburg International Mercantile Exchange, placing him at the centre of Russia's organised trading market for petroleum products.

Maslov moved into regional infrastructure in 2013 as chief executive of Development Corporation, whose projects included rail, power and mineral-development schemes in the Urals. That appointment ended three years later. Since 2019, he has served as chief executive of STG-Oil, a small privately held oil company. That role establishes management, not ownership, and its shareholders are not publicly identified. His current investment portfolio and the business that produced his personal wealth therefore remain unresolved.
